CITY COUNCIL
  REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
  SEPTEMBER 1, 2026 – 7:00 P.M.
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  5938 KAUFFMAN AVENUE - TEMPLE CITY

PUBLIC PARTICIPATION AND REMOTE ACCESS INSTRUCTIONS
Pursuant to California law, this meeting will be conducted in a hybrid format, allowing both in-
person and remote participation.

IN-PERSON PARTICIPATION
Members of the public may attend the meeting in person at City Council Chambers and provide
public comment by submitting a speaker card to the City Clerk prior to the item being considered.

WRITTEN COMMENT
Written public comments received by 5pm on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City
Council and made part of the meeting record. Written public comments will not be read aloud by
city staff or City Council.

REMOTE PARTICIPATION (ZOOM)
Members of the public may participate in the meeting via Zoom using the following information:
• Zoom Link: https://us06web.zoom.us/j/89390123562, Webinar/Meeting ID: 893 9012 3562

To provide public comment via Zoom:
1. Click the Zoom link or join using the Meeting ID.
2. Your microphone will be unmuted during one of the comment period outlined above. The City
  Clerk will add your name to the speaker list and you will be called upon to make a comment.
  When called, you will be unmuted and given the opportunity to speak.

TELEPHONE PARTICIPATION
Members of the public may also participate by telephone:

•  Dial: 1-646-568-7788
•  Enter Meeting ID when prompted - 893 9012 3562
•  Press *9 to raise your hand to speak.

PUBLIC COMMENT PROCEDURES
Public comments will be taken in the order received, including both in-person and remote
speakers.

• Each speaker will be limited to 3 minutes unless otherwise determined by the Mayor.
• The City will make reasonable efforts to ensure that remote public comment is provided on an
  equal basis with in-person comment.
   City Council Agenda
  September 1, 2026
  Page 2 of 6

You have the opportunity to address the City Council at the following times:
•  Agenda item: at the time the Council considers the agenda item;
•  Non-agenda item: at the time for PUBLIC COMMENTS. Please note that while the City Council
  values your comments, pursuant to the Brown Act, the Council cannot take action on any item not
  listed on the agenda; and
•  Public Hearing: at the time for public hearings under PUBLIC HEARING.

  The listing of any item on the agenda includes the authority of the Council to take action
  on such item and to approve, disapprove, or give directions on any item

  SUBMISSION OF WRITTEN COMMENTS
  Written comments may be submitted in advance to cityclerk@templecityca.gov 24 hours prior
  to the meeting. Written comments will be distributed to the City Council but will not be read
  aloud by staff or the City Council.

  TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS
  In the event of a disruption to the Zoom platform or telephone access that prevents public
  participation, the City Council will take appropriate steps to restore access. If access cannot be
  restored, the meeting may be recessed or adjourned to ensure compliance with applicable
  law.

  ACCESSIBILITY
  Pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), if you require special assistance to
  participate in this meeting, please contact the City Clerk’s Office at (626) 285-2171 or via email
  at cityclerk@templecityca.gov at least 72 hours prior to the meeting.

  NOTICE: Staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business of this
  Agenda are available for viewing on the City’s website at templcityca.gov and are on file and
  available for review during regular office hours in the Office of the City Clerk located at City Hall,
  9701 Las Tunas Drive, Temple City, California. Written documentation submitted to the City
  Council after distribution of the agenda packet can be obtained at the City Clerk’s Office during
  regular office hours.

  TO WATCH COUNCIL MEETINGS LIVE OR RECORDED, VISIT
  https://www.youtube.com/@ConnectWithTC

  AGENDA NOTIFICATION SUBSCRIPTION
  If you wish to receive an agenda email notification, please email your request to
  cityclerk@templecity.us or call (626) 285-2171.
